name: Handmade Belgian pralines
where: Mary, Rue Royale, or Neuhaus, Galerie de la Reine
about: Belgium is famous for its chocolate, and pralines are the classic gift from Brussels. Each piece has a soft filling inside a thin chocolate shell.
tip: Check the production date and storage temperature before you buy.

name: Dandoy speculoos
about: Speculoos is a crisp, spiced biscuit that has been baked in Brussels for generations. Dandoy is one of the oldest bakeries in the city.
tip: Choose a box that is sealed well so the biscuits stay crisp for the trip home.

name: Belgian lace
about: Brussels lace is known for its fine handmade work and has long been linked to the city's craft history. Lace is often sold as a small, easy-to-carry gift.
tip: Look for a label that says handmade, and check whether the item is made in China.
